claim: Counting hook instructions as nothing keeps the original and patched machines in lockstep, so the whole 128K can be compared per frame with no per-site pairing; it works only where game instructions stay the same.
limit: Only where game instructions are unchanged.

evidence.text: Whole 128K compared per frame with no per-site pairing, every hook counted as nothing; lockstep IDENTICAL on all 4 recordings (33,534 frames).
